method: Each claim checked against the retrieved text of the source PDF (12 of 108 pages), not the citation. Sections not retrieved are listed as unresolved rather than written.
source_coverage: pages 1-12 of 108 retrieved; treatment sections (pp. 82-86) NOT retrieved

claims.claim: Commonwealth publication, Heart Foundation with ACDPA, endorsed by RACGP, CC BY-NC-ND 4.0
claims.source_text: developed by the National Heart Foundation of Australia (Heart Foundation) in collaboration with the Australian Chronic Disease Prevention Alliance ... This guideline is endorsed by the Royal Australian College of General Practitioners (RACGP) ... licensed ... under a Creative Commons Attribution - Non-commercial - No Derivative Works (CC BY-NC-ND) 4.0 licence

claims.claim: Scope is people without known CVD
claims.source_text: Cardiovascular disease (CVD) risk assessment and management in people without known CVD

claims.claim: Assess all people without known CVD from 45-79; diabetes from 35-79 (conditional)
claims.source_text: For all people without known CVD, assess CVD risk from age 45 to 79 years. For people with diabetes without known CVD, assess CVD risk from age 35 to 79 years. | Conditional

claims.claim: First Nations: individual risk factors 18-29, calculator 30-79 (consensus)
claims.source_text: For First Nations people without known CVD: assess individual CVD risk factors from age 18 to 29 years; assess CVD risk using the Australian cardiovascular disease risk calculator from age 30 to 79 years. | Consensus

claims.claim: Clinically determined high risk: sustained eGFR <45, men uACR >25 mg/mmol, women uACR >35 mg/mmol
claims.source_text: people with sustained eGFR <45mL/min/1.73m2 or men with persistent uACR >25mg/mmol or women with persistent uACR >35mg/mmol

claims.claim: Confirmed familial hypercholesterolaemia is clinically determined high risk
claims.source_text: Assess CVD risk as high for people with a confirmed diagnosis of familial hypercholesterolaemia

claims.claim: Do not use the calculator in those already known to be high risk (moderate-to-severe CKD, FH)
claims.source_text: Do not use calculator in those already known to be at high risk: Moderate-to-severe CKD and FH

claims.claim: Risk categories: high >=10%, intermediate 5 to <10%, low <5%, over 5 years
claims.source_text: The new CVD risk categories are: high (>=10% risk over 5 years), intermediate (5 to <10% risk over 5 years), low (<5% risk over 5 years)

claims.claim: High risk: prescribe BP-lowering and lipid-modifying pharmacotherapy; formal reassessment not generally required
claims.source_text: High | >=10% | Prescribe blood pressure-lowering and lipid-modifying pharmacotherapy. | Formal reassessment of CVD risk is not generally required.

claims.claim: Intermediate: consider pharmacotherapy depending on clinical context; reassess every 2 years if not on pharmacotherapy
claims.source_text: Intermediate | 5% to <10% | Consider blood pressure-lowering and lipid-modifying pharmacotherapy, depending on clinical context. | Reassess risk every 2 years if not currently receiving pharmacotherapy

claims.claim: Low: pharmacotherapy not routinely recommended; reassess every 5 years
claims.source_text: Low | <5% | Pharmacotherapy is not routinely recommended. | Reassess risk every 5 years.

claims.claim: First Nations people reassess every year or at least every 2 years
claims.source_text: For First Nations people, reassess every year as part of an annual health check (or opportunistically) or at least every 2 years.

claims.claim: Calculator based on PREDICT-1 equation from a New Zealand cohort, recalibrated for Australia
claims.source_text: based on the PREDICT-1° equation, which was developed from a large New Zealand population cohort study. The calculator has been modified and recalibrated for the Australian population and health setting

claims.claim: Calculator inputs include age, sex, smoking, TC:HDL-C ratio, diabetes status, CVD medicines, postcode, AF history; diabetes adds HbA1c, time since diagnosis, uACR, eGFR, BMI, insulin
claims.source_text: Age, sex; Smoking status; TC: HDL-C ratio; Diabetes status; CVD medicines; Postcode; History of AF ... For people with diabetes: HbA1c, Time since diagnosis of diabetes, uACR, eGFR, Insulin ... body mass index (BMI) and the use of insulin in the previous 6 months

claims.claim: Usable in people already on BP-lowering, lipid-modifying or antithrombotic therapy
claims.source_text: can be used for people being treated with blood pressure-lowering, lipid-modifying and/or antithrombotic pharmacotherapy, as it includes a variable that accounts for treatment

claims.claim: New categories are NOT interchangeable with the 2012 Framingham-based equation categories
claims.source_text: The new categories are not directly interchangeable with previous 2012 Guidelines for the management of absolute cardiovascular disease risk equation categories. This difference has resulted in different risk percentile ranges

claims.claim: Reclassification factors: ethnicity, eGFR and uACR, severe mental illness, coronary artery calcium score, family history of premature CVD
claims.source_text: Reclassification factors include ethnicity, eGFR and uACR measurements, severe mental illness, coronary artery calcium score and family history of premature CVD

claims.claim: Family history of premature CVD defined as CHD or stroke in a first-degree female relative <65 or male relative <55
claims.source_text: Family history of premature CVD: coronary heart disease or stroke in a first-degree female relative aged <65 years or a first-degree male relative aged <55 years

claims.claim: Severe mental illness defined as a current or recent condition requiring specialist treatment, whether received or not, in the 5 years prior
claims.source_text: Severe mental illness: a current or recent mental health condition requiring specialist treatment, whether received or not, in the 5 years prior to the CVD risk assessment

claims.claim: Guideline prefers 'risk estimate' over 'absolute risk'
claims.source_text: The term 'risk estimate' is preferred over 'absolute risk' in this guideline

claims.claim: Pharmacotherapy qualified as unless contraindicated or clinically inappropriate, with shared decision-making
claims.source_text: Unless contraindicated or clinically inappropriate, and in discussion with the person on the benefits and harms of treatment. Encourage shared decision-making.

claims.claim: PBS: all first-line BP-lowering and lipid-modifying agents unrestricted; PCSK9 and inclisiran authority; alirocumab not listed
